items.title: What Could IBM (IBM) Gain From Its First Dual Architecture Mainframe Processor?
items.summary: IBM (NYSE:IBM) announced a new dual-architecture mainframe processor for IBM Z and LinuxONE, developed with Arm, that can execute IBM and Arm instructions on the same chip. The processor allows enterprise workloads to run natively across IBM mainframe and Arm platforms, expanding application and infrastructure options for large organizations. This is the first time IBM mainframe systems will support concurrent execution of both Arm and IBM instructions, aimed at wider workload flexibility...
